R2_CUSTOMER_6870.text:
I've had the same pair of Dr Martens boots for 4 years now and although the upper is fine, the sole was almost worn through. 
The repair service is cheaper than buying a second hand pair and much better for the environment, so I thought I would give it a go. 
You get to choose the colour of your sole, the weld and the stitching, which was fun.
I put them in an old shoebox and printed out the pre-paid label (no, you don't have to pay for postage). This was on a Thursday and they were collected by Royal Mail the following day.
I got an update once they had received my boots and an update just a few days later to say the repairs were complete and my boots were on their way back to me. 
A week after they were collected from Royal Mail, they were delivered to me by UPS. 
They look brand new! The welding is great, the sole is perfect and even better is that they added a brand new pair of laces. 
I am really pleased with the professionalism and the quick turnaround (being the height of summer probably helped as I doubt they have many Dr Martens to work on).
I would highly recommend this and would most certainly use them again, as long as my boots last!
